title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.27376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. Weight merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) must re-consolidate the whole model whenever an expert is added, and can erode capabilities outside the target domains. We propose Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation (CSPD), which keeps the pre-RL model frozen, distills each RL expert independently into a soft prompt, and composes experts by concatenating their prompts without joint training. A single soft prompt suffices to distill an RL expert, recovering at least 90% of the teacher's gain in 22 of 23 math, code, and agent settings. Independently trained prompts compose well. In a multi-expert setting, the average rises with every expert added, and the full composition matches MOPD (67.83 vs. 67.79). The composition generalizes best across six

translated_title: RL专家的可组合软提示蒸馏：迈向持续后训练
translated_abstract: RL后训练通常会产生领域专家模型，这些专家随后必须被整合到一个模型中，而随着新专家不断出现，这种整合就成为了一个持续的过程。权重合并和多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）在每添加一个专家时都必须重新整合整个模型，并且可能损害目标领域之外的能力。我们提出了可组合软提示蒸馏（CSPD），该方法保持RL之前的模型冻结，将每个RL专家独立地蒸馏到一个软提示中，并通过直接拼接各提示来组合专家，无需联合训练。单个软提示就足以蒸馏一个RL专家，在23个数学、代码和智能体设置中的22个里恢复了至少90%的教师增益。独立训练的提示之间可以良好组合。在多专家设置中，平均性能随着每个专家的加入而提升，完整组合的性能与MOPD相当（67.83 vs. 67.79）。该组合在六个……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出可组合软提示蒸馏（CSPD）方法，将每个RL专家独立蒸馏为软提示并通过拼接方式组合，无需重新整合模型即可实现持续后训练，性能媲美多教师蒸馏且不损害目标领域之外的能力。
